text:
This document describes the parental leave policy for all full time employees.

Employees are entitled to sixteen weeks of paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. Leave may be taken in one continuous block or split into two blocks within the first year after the qualifying event.

Unused vacation may carry over up to 10 days into the next calendar year. Carry over days must be used within the first quarter of the new year or they are forfeited.

Full time employees accrue 25 vacation days per year, prorated for employees who join mid year.

Parental leave applies to all full time employees regardless of tenure. There is no minimum service requirement to qualify for this benefit.

Employees must notify their manager at least 30 days before the expected start of leave, except in cases of premature birth or a medical emergency.

During parental leave, employees continue to receive full health insurance coverage at no additional cost to them.
title: Parental Leave Policy
